meta.method: see shear_measure.py header; uncalibrated, cluster members not removed

shear.note: Control: the nebula has few background galaxies; filament structure is not removed, so this is not a lensing detection.

meta.convention: pa = position angle of the polarization (E-vector), degrees from North through East; ASSUMED zero point; instrumental polarization not corrected

pol.note: HST ACS/WFC F606W through POL0V/60V/120V (2003), ideal-polarizer Stokes, 3-arcsec cells. Position-angle zero point ASSUMED (V3 offset -38.15 deg); instrumental polarization (~2%) not corrected. NICMOS (1997) agrees with ACS to 9.8 deg rms after one fitted offset.
